The Real Red Alert: Massive Corruption - A Patriotic Letter to the Men and Women in Uniform and to All Filipino Compatriots 🇵🇭✊

To our brothers and sisters in uniform,❤🙏✊

At this critical moment in our nation’s history, you have once again been placed on red alert. But let us ask: red alert for what, and for whom?

Red alert should not only be a call to tighten security in the streets—it should be a call to open our eyes to the real and most dangerous threat to the Republic: massive corruption that is bleeding and rotting our country to the core. The plunder of public funds, particularly in flood control projects, is but the tip of the iceberg. We are only scratching the surface of a system, a government, that is rotting the foundations of our nation. While Filipinos wade through floods and poverty, crocodiles in power grow fat from the people’s sweat and blood.

The truth is plain: the Philippines is on fire. The Republic is in a state of moral conflagration. This, more than anything else, is what should alarm the men and women in uniform. For plunder, corruption does not choose its victims. It affects farmers, workers, teachers, soldiers, and even policemen. It imperils not just today’s generation but also your children and your children’s children.

When the Republic is bleeding, a true red alert is not sounded against the people who cry out for justice, accountability, transparency, and real and genuine change for a better Philippines. It is sounded against those who BETRAY the public trust. And in this struggle, you, the protectors of the state, are not mere spectators. You are part of the nation, bound by oath to protect the people and secure the sovereignty, dignity, and integrity of the state —the Republic —not to shield the corrupt or silence the cries of the Filipino people for justice. 

The real enemy is the massive corruption and the crocodiles in government, and the real mission is accountability, transparency, genuine change, and nation-building. The Constitution you swore to uphold declares that your PRIMORDIAL DUTY IS TO SERVE AND PROTECT THE PEOPLE and the REPUBLIC!  

Never forget that you are Filipinos first before you are soldiers or policemen. The people you see in the rallies are not adversaries. They are your countrymen, your neighbors, your families, your fellow patriots.

We therefore call on you:
• Stand with the nation!
• Direct your vigilance not against the people’s outrage but against the massive corruption that fuels it.
• Remember that the red alert you are placed under today is a metaphor for the red warning light flashing on the very heart of our Republic.

History will remember whether you stood as instruments of a corrupt regime or as guardians of the people and of democracy. The hour demands courage, not blind obedience; patriotism, not partisanship; loyalty to the people and to the Republic, not to the plunderers and the corrupt politicians. 

The country is calling. Let us rise together as one nation, one people, one Republic under the banner and colors of the Philippine flag! 

Let the real red alert be the fire in our hearts to defend truth, justice, and the future of the country.

For the Republic. For the Filipino people. For the generations yet to come. Our brothers and sisters in uniform, Defend Truth. Uphold Justice. Secure the future of the Filipino People and the Republic.

The call is clear: Magkaisa! Lumaban! Ipagtanggol ang Bayan!!!

Mabuhay ang Pilipinas!!!🇵🇭🇵🇭🇵🇭✊✊

#ProPhilippines       

P.S. pass on the message…😊🙏🙏

TRAFFIC ADVISORY: LASG SET TO COMMENCE REPAIR OF OZUMBA MBADIWE ROAD

The Lagos State Government has announced its plan to carry out repair works on the stretch of Ozumba Mbadiwe Road from Bonny Camp junction, from Monday, 15th to Sunday, 21st September 2025.

The repair works will take place at night from 9.00 pm to 6.00 am to ensure minimal impact on traffic.

Motorists are, therefore, urged to be patient while driving through the corridor.

Mr. Oluwaseun Osiyemi,
Lagos State Commissioner for Transportation.

@jidesanwoolu @drobafemihamzat @seunosiyemi_ @lagosMOT1 @gbenga_omo @gboyegaakosile @BarrBimbola @Mr_JAGs @Riddwane
#AGreaterLagosRising 
#LASG
